verdict.rationale: Blaxel's own docs describe recurring scheduling in two places. Sandbox Schedules run a command on a cron schedule, at a future datetime, or after a delay, with execution history per run. Jobs can run batch AI workflows as scheduled or on-demand serverless jobs. Missing for 10: in-depth detail on job scheduling configuration (cron syntax, retries, failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
